{{Quote|All right, this is a Code Aurek alert. I want each of you to search every nook, every cranny, for a place this Rodent could be hiding.|[[Rex/Legends|Rex]]|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Mouse Hunt">''[[The Clone Wars: Mouse Hunt]]''</ref>}}
The '''Code Aurek''' was an alert code that was to bring a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] station on guard.

==History==
When [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] learned about [[Rodent (droid)|Rodent]], a glitchy [[MSE-series]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that cleaned the station for hours, Rex called out a Code Aurek signal to hunt down Rodent. It was revealed that Rodent was a [[Spy/Legends|espionage]] droid.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Mouse Hunt" />

*''[[The Clone Wars: Mouse Hunt]]''
